evals.name: entry-styles
evals.prompt: Load the Components baseline in a React application, naming the stylesheet and entry-point imports.
evals.expected_output: One stylesheet loads the three package assets.
assertions: Imports tokens, styles and theme in order.
Mounts CratisComponentsProvider from the package root.

evals.name: scope-color
evals.prompt: Change the authors area's primary color without recoloring a neighboring Books panel.
evals.expected_output: A wrapper sets the primary-color token.
assertions: Sets --cratis-primary-color on an authors-specific CSS selector.
Applies that class to the Authors wrapper.
Leaves sibling components outside the override.

evals.name: parts
evals.prompt: Style the inner table header and the supporting text of a ComboBox option in the Authors area.
evals.expected_output: Use scoped selectors for the published parts.
assertions: Selects data-cratis-part='header-content' for inner header content.
Scopes the portaled options with a class on pt.popover rather than assuming they are inside the author panel.

evals.name: app-palette
evals.prompt: Set the library's primary color for light, explicit dark and system dark mode.
evals.expected_output: Unlayered rules after the theme import cover the root and themed subtrees.
assertions: Matches the baseline root, theme and explicit light selectors including light within dark.
Sets the dark value on :root.cratis-dark, .cratis-dark .cratis-theme and .cratis-theme.cratis-dark.
Repeats the dark value under prefers-color-scheme: dark on :root:not(.cratis-light) and .cratis-theme:not(.cratis-light).
